reviews.title: Must have!
reviews.contents: 2.79$ only a couple months ago when i found out i was pregant and it’s honestly so much worth! I go on it every single morning. This app is a must while expecting!

reviews.title: Best app for me
reviews.contents:
This is my third time using this app. I decided to try a differed one but it was not as good as this one. Weight tracking is one of my favourite features and the daily newsfeeds; I look forward to them. It makes sense, it’s precise and to the point. 
I also like the images and examples of what baby looks like. Everything I want throughout my pregnancy is right here.

reviews.contents: Since the last update i dont have access to any feed and got a message about no network connections found

reviews.title: Fabulous!
reviews.contents: Amazing app. Full of information, photos :-) really helped to enjoy this amazing time!

reviews.title: Problème
reviews.contents: Mon appli n'a pas changé le temps que je suis rendu aujourd'hui, la date en haut a changé mais je suis toujours a 15,6 semaines alors que je suis rendu à 16 semaines. Que faire??

reviews.title: Great
reviews.contents: This app makes me feel more bonded to my baby, i was denial and scared at first but this app truly helps me understand what is happening.

reviews.title: I highly recommend this app
reviews.contents: This app has everything I could want in it. It gives you daily articles to read about your pregnancy and they pertain to where you are in your pregnancy. It gives you weekly updates of what’s going on, a cute 3D picture of what your baby would look like as it grows. This is a great tool for first time pregnancies!

reviews.title: Updated: Ads in Premium!! Love most features, articles are hit or miss
reviews.contents:
Updating my review: I re-downloaded this app for my second pregnancy and paid for a year of premium just like last time. The app has updated since then, and now it is littered with "sponsored" content (ads!) EVEN IN PREMIUM! What are you guys doing??

I love the weekly updates on your baby's development, and I like reading the articles, but they're very hit-or-miss; especially the articles relevant to later stages of pregnancy vary a lot in quality. Some are great, some are barely legible and quite poorly written. 

There's also an obsessive emphasis on yoga - according to this app, pregnancy yoga is the answer to every possible problem, it seems. They would definitely benefit from exploring other options for women who aren't interested in having yoga shoved down their throats. 

Also, please come up with a better term than "Birth Partner" - or at least let me rename the hospital  bag list! It sounds so weird!!
